title: Root tower projections and normalized finite tensor reduction
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and a scheme $T$ on which $\ell$ is invertible [def-pc-scheme]. On the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] use the root sheaves $M_{s,T}=\mu_{\ell^s,T}^{\mathrm{pro}}$ with transitions $u\mapsto u^\ell$ [def-pur-roots-of-unity-sheaf], and let $L_T=\varprojlim_{s\geq1}M_{s,T}$ with projections $p_{s,T}$ [def-pur-sheaf-inverse-limit]. Put $Z_T=(\mathbf Z_\ell)_T$ and $R_{s,T}=(\mathbf Z/\ell^s)_T$, with constant sheaves [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] and $\ell$-adic integers [def-weil-l-adic-numbers]. The $Z_T$-action on $L_T$ is $(a x)_s=x_s^{a\bmod\ell^s}$, extended from constant scalars by sheafification. Use ordinary sheaf tensors [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product].

For every $r\geq1$, $p_{r,T}$ is locally surjective, and for every site object $U$,
$$\ker(p_{r,T}(U))=\ell^rL_T(U).$$
Here the kernel is in additive notation, so $p_r(x)=1$ in root notation. More precisely, for such an $x$ the compatible tuple $d_r(x)_s=x_{s+r}$ belongs to $M_{s,T}(U)$, satisfies $\ell^r d_r(x)=x$, and commutes with restrictions.

For any commutative $\mathbf Z_\ell$-algebra $B$ with $\ell^rB=0$, let $B_T$ be its constant ring sheaf and put $H_T=L_T\otimes_{Z_T}B_T$. The $B_T$-linear map
$$\alpha_{r,T}:H_T\longrightarrow M_{r,T}\otimes_{R_{r,T}}B_T,\qquad x\otimes b\longmapsto p_{r,T}(x)\otimes b$$
is an isomorphism. Its inverse is normalized as follows: for local sections $u$ of $M_{r,T}$ and $b$ of $B_T$, the section $\alpha_{r,T}^{-1}(u\otimes b)$ is the unique gluing of $x_i\otimes b|_{U_i}$ for any cover on which lifts $p_r(x_i)=u|_{U_i}$ exist; this value is independent of the cover and the lifts. There is no flatness assumption on $B$ over $\mathbf Z/\ell^r$.

proof.text: Use the proved epimorphic root transitions [lem-pur-twist-root-transitions]. Forget additive structure to obtain a sequence of set sheaves with epimorphic transitions. The forgetful functor preserves this limit. Pro-etale repleteness [det-pe-replete-epimorphism] makes every set-valued limit projection epic; transport along the preserved-limit isomorphism and use [lem-weil-pbc-site-sheaf-sets-epi-locally-surjective] to obtain local surjectivity of the additive root projection.

source.place: Tag 03PL, lemma-kummer-sequence; proetale.tex Tag 0990, lemma-proetale-enough-w-contractible, via the existing repleteness theorem

proof.text: Iterate the transition identity on the underlying units. If the positive r-th coordinate of x vanishes, its positive (s+r)-th coordinate is killed by ell^s and hence determines an s-th root. These roots form a compatible cone, whose limit section d_r(x) has the required coordinates. The same transition identity gives ell^r d_r(x)=x. Conversely the r-th root group is killed by ell^r. Injectivity of root inclusions and sectionwise limit extensionality prove that d_r commutes with restrictions.

source.place: Section 03PK, section-kummer: root equations; agent shift calculation using the sectionwise limit of sites-modules.tex Tags 03DB and 03CO

proof.text: Restrict the completed scalar action to constant ell-adic scalars. Its defining coordinate equation makes the root projection linear for reduction to the constant residue ring. Mathlib PadicInt.ker_toZModPow and RingHom.liftOfSurjective show that the algebra map to B factors through this residue ring, since ell^r vanishes in B. The normalized scalar-extension lift [lem-sp-scalar-extension-binary-coherence] defines the forward morphism and computes its value on pure tensors.

source.place: Section 03EK, section-tensor-product, and Tag 03CY, lemma-sheafification-presheaf-modules; agent specialization to the root projection

proof.text: Use the canonical scalar-extension embedding [lem-sp-scalar-extension-dual-tower-core]. Its composite with the kernel inclusion of p_r is zero: step 2 writes every kernel section as ell^r y, and preservation of natural-number multiplication makes its image zero because ell^r vanishes in the coefficient sheaf. The projection is epic by step 1. Mathlib Abelian.epiDesc therefore constructs the unique additive descent q from finite roots, satisfying p_r followed by q equal to the tensor embedding. This is the categorical gluing of local lifts; no witnesses of arbitrary mere existence are used as data.

source.place: Section 03EK, section-tensor-product; agent gluing argument from steps 1 and 2

proof.text: Regard the target as a residue-ring module by restriction of scalars. Any additive map between modules over a constant residue-ring sheaf is linear: restrict along its sheafification unit, represent each residue by an integer, and use preservation of integer multiplication. Mathlib PresheafOfModules.restrictHomEquivOfIsLocallySurjective descends this linearity from the constant presheaf. Apply this to q and extend scalars using the normalized scalar-extension lift to obtain the B-linear reverse map.

source.place: Section 03EK and Tag 03CY; sites.tex Tag 00WK, lemma-sections-sheafification; agent balancing check

proof.text: The reverse map takes p_r(x) tensor b to x tensor b by the descent equation. Pure-tensor extensionality proves one inverse identity. Cancel the epic p_r to prove that q followed by the forward map is the finite tensor embedding; this gives the other identity by the same extensionality theorem. For any covering sieve and prescribed local lifts, naturality of the isomorphism and of pure tensors proves the reverse implication of the normalization. Conversely the local gluing equations imply that the forward image is the prescribed finite tensor by sheaf separatedness, and application of the inverse gives the claimed equality. No flatness hypothesis enters.

proof_origin.place: C3: sectionwise root-kernel shift, normalized scalar-extension API, and Mathlib abelian epimorphism descent. Root transitions and pro-etale repleteness supply local surjectivity; scalar balancing is descended along the constant-sheaf unit. This is the categorical realization of the gluing argument of Section 03EK and Tag 03CY.

tool_uses.why: Kummer local lifting on the arbitrary scheme U; the unit has no general root-transition exactness statement.
An etale lifting cover is a cover for the pro-etale topology used here.
Etale lifting maps are weakly etale, so they compose to objects of the given site.
Weakly etale composites ensure the lifting schemes remain objects over T.
Converts sectionwise local root lifts to categorical epis and converts limit epis back to local lifts.
The general sequential-limit projection theorem supplies a compatible infinite root lift; it is a generic pro-etale topos tool.
The definition gives the componentwise compatible-tuple description.
The root equation and power transitions are the definitions needed for the explicit kernel shift.
Uses ordinary sheaf tensor construction rather than any derived tensor or flatness result.
Its extension universal property extends the balanced presheaf maps and tests their composites.
The scalar ring is sheafification of a constant ring presheaf.
Locally represents a section of the constant residue ring by a residue, to check balancing with an integer lift.

Step 1: Kummer on U (lem-amb-kummer-any-base, ℓ invertible on U) gives an étale cover with v^ℓ=u, and v^{ℓ^{s+1}}=1 puts v in M_{s+1}. The cover is pro-étale and its members are weakly étale over T. Repleteness (det-pe-replete-epimorphism) and the set-sheaf epi criterion then make p_r epi and locally surjective. Step 2: checked y_s=x_{s+r}, y_s^{ℓ^s}=x_r=1, (ℓ^r y)_s=x_s, the converse, and naturality. Steps 3-6: α is Z_T-balanced because Z_ℓ→B factors through Z/ℓ^r. Lift differences ℓ^r y give y⊗ℓ^r b=0. For R_r-balancing, c is locally a constant residue (00WK lemma) and an integer lift is used. Both composites are the identity on pure tensors, and uniqueness of the extension through sheafification makes them equal as sheaf maps. No flatness is used. Edge cases: separably closed point with B=F_ℓ and r=2, B=0, T empty, r=1. Accepted tool_uses: det-pe-replete-epimorphism, lem-weil-pbc-site-sheafification-sections-local, det-pe-morphisms-etale-comparison(1); the Kummer and epi-criterion units are in sk-prop-an's uses. Acyclic; no SGA; Stacks tags 03PL/0990/03EK/03CY/00WK/03DB/03CO all resolve. No whole-item duplicate: lem-pur-twist-sheaf-locally-free(2) is over the completed Ẑ_ℓ, only for Z/ℓ^r, and has no normalized inverse. Advisory: lem-pur-twist-root-transitions already states that root transitions are epi; step 1's correct, on-route re-derivation is kept. No fixes.
